newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products all easier on crude, slow buying.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products all easier on crude, slow buying.

text.p: NWE oil products were weaker on Tuesday, traders said.
Gas oil slid $5.25 on easier futures. Premiums were steady to slightly easier. Lack of vessels and poor demand hit volume.
Fuel oil was generally softer with high sulphur barges easing to $109 fob ARA after morning trade at $111.
Gasoline lost about $2 a tonne on the back of easier crude and U.S. gasoline futures. European demand was slack.
Naphtha was also weaker by $5 a tonne or so. Russian cargoes were seen, but no were heard bought.
